usage: Use implementation.cssText as a stylesheet, or use the supplied dyson-inspired.css.
Add class="dyson-inspired" to the page body or a wrapper around the area being restyled.
Map your existing markup to the supplied brand-* component classes, or adapt their selectors.
The font stack uses local fonts only unless your project separately supplies a licensed @font-face definition.
The CSS does not implement menus, carts, dialog focus management or other application logic.
aria-disabled only styles an element; disable its behavior in your application. Use the disabled attribute on native buttons.
Review contrast on custom imagery and surfaces, keyboard navigation, responsive layouts and font fallbacks in your own site.
